description.zh:
导播台ID。
- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you call the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation to create a production studio, obtain the CasterId from the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The ID of the production studio is its name in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page.

description.zh: 布局ID。如果您通过[AddCasterLayout接口](~~2848025~~)添加导播台布局，请查看AddCasterLayout接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值。
description.en: The layout ID. If you call the [AddCasterLayout](~~2848025~~) operation to add a layout to the production studio, obtain the LayoutId from the response.

descriptions.zh:
先通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，再调用本接口删除导播台布局数据。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Call the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation to create a production studio. You can then call this operation to delete a layout in the production studio.

## QPS limit

This operation is limited to 10 queries per second (QPS) for each user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-caster-layout --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --layout-id 21926b36-7dd2-4fde-ae25-51b5bc8e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
